title: How Real People Are Really Living On Crypto In Real Life
description:
​If you're curious about the ins and outs of keeping your financial life discreet, consider learning from the pros whose income depends on discretion.

In this workshop, you'll learn from a team of people whose economic lives exist almost exclusively outside of traditional financial institutions. From groceries, to rent, and yes, even income, there's no bank account required. We've spent the last couple of years educating vulnerable populations including adult industry workers, LGBTQ+ individuals, and others about income-preserving and privacy-protecting financial options, such as shielded Zcash.

​During the session, you'll learn how to:
- Start receiving Zcash immediately. (No account required.)
- ​Receive Zcash even if your customer only has Bitcoin (or a different currency).
- ​Spend the Zcash you earn equally privately.
-​ Protect yourself from stressful price volatility.
- Legitimise your crypto earnings when you need to,
- and more.
